summary: test(ci): make benchmark runs execute tests and fix the admin-server check
description:
Because:

- nx replayed cached test results on reruns, understating test job times
- The admin-server health check used port 8090; it listens on 8095

This commit:

- Adds an NX_BENCH_RUN env input to test targets, set to the workflow id (benchmark only)
- Points the admin-server health check at port 8095
